frozen_semantic_layers.A_STRATEGY: All reference_sources, strategy parameters, causal availability, errors, Open/Close ordering, one-shot ownership, risk, entries, stops, exits and costs remain unchanged.
frozen_semantic_layers.B_METRICS_AND_SCREENING: The frozen DEVELOPMENT metric_contract, segment_contract, verdict_contract and result_schema remain authoritative; no local thresholds or alternate verdict.
frozen_semantic_layers.C_LOGICAL_NATIVE_RESULT: Complete original native result with every field, ordered record and exact numeric spelling. Storage introduces no logical schema variant.
frozen_semantic_layers.D_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE: Versioned external bundle, lossless byte shards, summary projection and audit witnesses. This wrapper is not itself a native result and never substitutes a reduced schema.

governance_exception.fallback_if_not_accepted: Original native-byte cap still applies; remain BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY. Do not choose another option or start a run.
governance_exception.precedence: Only the enumerated physical-delivery/cap-accounting exception may apply after all activation gates. Every strategy, metric, schema, equality, source-binding, attempt-limit and safety requirement remains binding. Unenumerated conflicts fail closed.
targets: architecture_addendum.computational_exception.allowed: physical delivery may be a lossless bundle instead of one persisted monolithic JSON file
architecture_addendum.scalability_plan.bounded_execution.output_size_cap_bytes: proposed physical workspace accounting instead of reconstructed logical stream length
architecture_addendum.scalability_plan.schema_feasibility_blocker: exact streamed reconstruction and independently equivalent streamed validation remain mandatory

checks: All required shard bytes exist; stored/decoded SHA, sizes, order, offsets, codec, stream digests and canonical final LF match.
Original result_schema and every x-cross-field-invariant hold, with no float, nonfinite value, duplicate JSON key, missing record or altered rational spelling.
Regime/context/pullback/confirmation/stop/risk/entry/exit provenance joins reconcile; quantities, terminal states, source clocks and record order remain immutable.
Count every lifecycle category, fill, trade, direction and approved filled quantity exactly once from detailed records. Reconcile closed+open with entries and exit types with closed trades.
Independently recompute effective fills, actual fees and net closed-trade PnL from base fills, actions and frozen quantities/costs; diagnostic slippage is never deducted again.
Reconcile open positions and paid entry fees with no hypothetical exit, forced liquidation or realized PnL for an open trade.

For every actual bar, independently derive realized net equity and still-open unrealized equity using the source Close witness, effective entry and paid entry fee; compare each mark. Verify source Close witnesses against immutable RAW in the separately authorized verification scope.

Recompute maximum marked-equity drawdown from starting peak zero, losses/streak with zero resetting, exact average/median, wins/losses/breakevens, profit factor including ZERO and POSITIVE_INFINITY, and win rate/null cases.

Compute exactly three equal elapsed-time segments from source bounds with rational microsecond boundaries; attribute closed trades and both costs by EXIT fill timestamp, S1/S2 half-open, S3 final-inclusive.
Recompute frozen sample-first screening, failed_criteria and next_gate. Compare every summary field to the audited native projection; diagnostic session counts cannot affect verdict.
independent_verifier.failure: FAIL_CLOSED_INCOMPLETE_OR_INCONSISTENT_EVIDENCE; no authoritative verdict and no automatic strategy retry.
independent_verifier.independence: Do not call the strategy runner or reuse its cached aggregates as the oracle. New audit arithmetic/stream validator must be separately source-bound and compared exactly with frozen metric/screening/schema authority on predeclared invented fixtures. No executable verifier is claimed now.
independent_verifier.input_boundary: Immutable stored audit and bound source mark witnesses; exact RAW-to-witness comparison only under future explicit source-verification authorization. No OOS access.
independent_verifier.streaming_requirements: Incremental UTF-8/JSON token parsing handles chunk-spanning tokens and large integers exactly. Use exact bounded big-integer parsing and disk-backed provenance joins/external median sorting where necessary. All temporary storage, verifier memory and re-reading costs are measured; no O(1) claim.

layer_1_decision_summary.authority: A convenience projection only. A summary cannot become an authoritative result until complete audit reconstruction, independent reconciliation and COMPLETE seal all pass.
layer_1_decision_summary.segment_coverage: Exactly the complete original S1/S2/S3 objects in original order; frozen net-PnL sample-first verdict and failed_criteria order.
layer_1_decision_summary.unrealized: Copy exact unrealized_pnl_at_end_usd and marked_equity_at_end_usd; open trade realized PnL remains null. No hypothetical exit fee/slippage or final liquidation.

layer_2_complete_audit.durability: All content-addressed objects and final manifests retained immutably on a demonstrated durable host; fsync/atomic publish after verification. Verify an independently retrievable complete bundle before declaring COMPLETE. Partial journals/checkpoints remain clearly INCOMPLETE.
layer_2_complete_audit.logical_native_result: Every byte of the canonical complete frozen result, including output_sha256 and final LF. Every repeated nested provenance occurrence is emitted; physical object sharing does not change logical multiplicity.

mark_source_witnesses.coverage: Exactly one witness per actual observation; no session filtering or gap filling.
mark_source_witnesses.format: Canonical UTF-8 JSON object plus LF per actual source observation, ordered by bar_index
mark_source_witnesses.purpose: The original mark schema stores equities but not the marking Close. This separate additive audit witness enables independent mark recomputation without adding fields to the frozen native result.
mark_source_witnesses.source_verification: In a separately authorized future verification gate, bind every witness to the exact immutable input row and RAW SHA. Merely hashing a claimed Close is not proof of origin. No strategy recalculation is needed. If source verification is unavailable, mark provenance verification INCOMPLETE.

layer_2_complete_audit.operational_receipts: Append-only START/progress/END or failure receipts with UTC, run/source/input bindings, phase, last completed actual index, physical byte counts and resource measurements. No receipt authorizes restart/resume or another strategy invocation.
layer_2_complete_audit.producer_design: Append-only immutable version journal plus disk-backed deterministic final-record indexes. Canonical source-order iterators emit every required final logical record. Journal/index equivalence must be proved against complete reference output; do not dump intermediate versions into a different native schema.
layer_2_complete_audit.required_rationals: Full exact native numerator/denominator integer tokens, with signs, positive denominators and original spelling; never expressions, IDs, rounded values or float.

A.evidence: Streaming can reduce materialization/copies but does not shrink fixed native bytes or exact operand growth. Historical 60.27 GB dense estimate exceeds native 8 GiB; real compliance not proven.

B.evidence: Lossless byte partition/concatenation preserves a complete logical result in principle. Physical compression/deduplication may help; no measured ratio, implemented verifier or cap compliance exists yet.

C.evidence: A larger durable host may change available resources but cannot waive the frozen limits. Requires separate authorization and measured capacity; no provider/environment selected.

D.evidence: Stopping preserves frozen research without an unsupported execution. Not chosen automatically; AGIcoreManager decision only.

physical_storage_contract.chunk_rule: Partition each exact canonical byte stream at offsets j*1048576. Every nonfinal chunk has exactly 1048576 bytes; final chunk is nonempty and at most that size. Boundaries may split a JSON record, integer token or UTF-8 sequence; only concatenated decoded bytes are parsed.

compression.choice_basis: Byte lengths only, never trading content/performance.
compression.runtime_binding: Exact compressor/decompressor library versions and binary/source identities pinned before future proof; codec profile SHA bound to source closure and bundle. Cross-version byte identity is not assumed.

physical_storage_contract.integrity: SHA-256 over each stored object and decoded chunk; ordered canonical manifest SHA commits all positions, lengths, codecs and whole decoded-stream SHA. An unordered set of hashes is insufficient.
physical_storage_contract.partial_policy: Incomplete object, absent descriptor, extra data, duplicate/conflicting ordinal, wrong offset/size/hash, codec mismatch, truncation, malformed JSON or failed invariant => FAIL_CLOSED, no COMPLETE result.
physical_storage_contract.path_policy: Hash-derived relative regular-file object names only; reject traversal, symlink, hardlink alias tricks and unbound objects. Never overwrite existing content; identical-object reuse requires exact verification.
physical_storage_contract.physical_deduplication: Allowed only for byte-identical stored objects with the same declared codec/decoded bytes. Every logical ordinal reference and repetition remains in the manifest.
physical_storage_contract.record_counts: Counts for every original array path and witness stream; reconciled from decoded content, not trusted manifest assertions.

preserved_work.commit_message: WIP: exact semantic repair complete; resource feasibility blocked; no real execution authorization
preserved_work.historical_bulk_log_limitation: 168 collected; terminal summary absent. Retain the limitation; no whole-suite PASS inferred from process exit or UI timeout.

preservation_recheck.verification_method: SHA256 and byte size of separately materialized original durable version; exact prefix comparison; no strategy or benchmark execution.

preserved_work.publication_method: GITHUB_CONNECTOR_IDENTICAL_TREE; direct git push unavailable without terminal credentials; commit metadata differs

reconstruction_contract.acyclic_rule: Each artifact may bind earlier artifacts only. Bundle manifest does not include summary/verification/seal hashes; none contains its own hash.
reconstruction_contract.completion_seal: A canonical separate final receipt binds manifest, summary and successful independent-verifier receipt hashes, native hashes/size, source/input/run identities and all required counts. Create only after full durable evidence and invariants PASS; process END alone is insufficient.

hash_distinction.bundle_manifest_sha256: SHA256(canonical physical manifest bytes plus final LF); external to that manifest.
hash_distinction.logical_native_file_sha256: SHA256(full canonical native JSON bytes INCLUDING output_sha256 and final LF).
hash_distinction.native_output_sha256: Frozen output_sha256 = SHA256(canonical native object with only output_sha256 omitted, plus final LF).
hash_distinction.summary_sha256: SHA256(canonical summary including bundle manifest commitment); recorded externally.

reconstruction_contract.mathematical_identity: For any finite byte sequence B, chunks C_j=B[j*m:min((j+1)*m,len(B))] cover disjoint contiguous intervals. concat(C_j)=B. A verified lossless codec preserves each C_j, therefore concatenated reconstruction equals B exactly. This partition identity proves no resource bound and does not prove producer or verifier implementation correctness.
procedure: Verify expected addendum, source closures, run identity and parent bindings; obtain the exact canonical bundle manifest and verify its independently recorded SHA.
For each required stream, verify ordered ordinals 0..n-1, offsets starting at zero, declared sizes and complete object presence before completion can be asserted.
Read each addressed object under resource controls, verify stored SHA/size and codec, decode with an enforced decoded-size bound, reject trailing compressed bytes and verify decoded SHA/size.
Concatenate decoded chunks in descriptor order into a bounded streaming hash/parser sink. Emit exact bytes unchanged; do not parse and rewrite values to claim byte equality.

Verify logical_native_file_sha256 over the entire canonical native stream including output_sha256 and final LF, its exact byte count, valid UTF-8, unique sorted object keys, canonical integer spelling and complete EOF.

Independently generate the canonical top-level payload stream with only output_sha256 omitted, including final LF, and verify its SHA equals the original embedded output_sha256. Use a real streaming parser/canonical emitter, never regex removal.

Apply the original JSON schema and all cross-field invariants with a separately proved equivalent bounded verifier. Check every original field/array/provenance/rational record, and independently reconcile summary metrics, segments and screening.

Require exact canonical-byte equality and both hashes against frozen-reference synthetic outputs. For large future verification, hash/parser sinks may avoid persisting an expanded file, but every logical byte must be decoded and validated.

resource_contract.byte_accounting: Sum max(file logical length, allocated storage bytes) for each retained regular file plus allocated directory metadata, across all output/temp roots and required coexisting copies. No sparse-file, hardlink or compression-ratio assumption. Preexisting immutable input and read-only code are not newly produced output; host capacity must still cover them.
resource_contract.future_failure_policy: If projected compliance and conservative capacity/headroom are not demonstrated, remain BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY. Any larger limit/environment requires its own explicit amendment; no automatic switch to C.

historical_estimates_only.basis: Conditional extrapolations from the historical dense invented workload, not DEVELOPMENT results, not compressed-output measurements and not guaranteed bounds.
historical_estimates_only.confidence: HIGH_UNCERTAINTY; actual real event density and rational cancellation unknown and not inspected.

resource_contract.logical_bytes: Track and hash every uncompressed native byte independently of compressed/physical sizes. Logical bytes may exceed 8 GiB only after the explicit interpretation exception is activated; never relabel compressed bytes as native size.
resource_contract.memory_scope: Peak memory of the complete supervised execution/serialization/verification process tree, including caches and decoder buffers; not just one serializer or per-process RSS in isolation. Demonstrate enforcement and available host capacity before approval.
resource_contract.proposed_physical_cap_scope: Peak total physical evidence workspace: compressed/identity objects, summary/manifests, witnesses, journals, indexes, logs, checkpoints, verifier spill files, partial writes and any reconstructed persisted copies. All contemporaneous output/temp locations count; no evasion by putting temporary files elsewhere.
resource_contract.temporary_storage: Measure peak coexistence of producer spools, immutable shards, verifier indexes and copies; compressed final size alone cannot establish the cap.

complete_fixture_procedure: Validate frozen reference native output and both native digest definitions before storage.
Generate proposed stored audit, witnesses and summary without modifying any native value.
Independently reconstruct all native bytes from shards, using a separate decoder/validator.
Validate reconstructed schema, ordered lifecycle/provenance and every cross-field invariant.
Compare exact canonical bytes and SHA256 with the original fixture: no identity normalization in storage roundtrip.
Independently derive detailed audit metrics, source-based marks, segments and screening; require exact summary equality.
Repeat complete storage/reconstruction in fresh processes; retain every failing fixture, source/output hash and log. No performance-based fixture or codec selection.
required_fixture_coverage: All already-declared bounded LONG/SHORT lifecycle scenarios, invalid-input status/error behavior and end states; no missing native categories.
No trades, one/two-contract closed trades, open trade at end, risk rejection, gap/intrabar stops, EMA exit and stop priority.
Exact rational values including negative and very large integers, null values, ZERO/POSITIVE_INFINITY PF, equality thresholds, zero-profit loss-streak reset and exact segment boundaries.
Invented gaps/off-session observations retained; one witness and mark per actual observation.
Repeated identical chunks with retained logical multiplicity, incompressible chunks, and inputs around chunk_size-1/chunk_size/chunk_size+1; UTF-8 and integer tokens crossing boundaries.
